## Personality

Gertie Pye has a habit of being late. She is also known for being jealous, frequently speaking ill of Julia behind her back.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

During a meeting of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), Gertie Pye announced that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) intended to rent his fence to a medicine company for painted advertisements. Her announcement prompted a committee of girls to attempt, unsuccessfully, to talk him out of the plan.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane-andrews.md)

Gertie Pye serves alongside [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) as a member of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's canvassing committee. During their work together for the society, Gertie brings key community matters to the attention of the group, such as Judson Parker's plans to rent his fence for advertisements.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P4](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0004), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), +2 more_

- Comrade of — canvassing committee members for the Improvement Society (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>

### [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--josie-pye.md)
